resumeText:
Vignesh Murugan | Chennai | vignesh.murugan@example.com

EDUCATION
B.E. Electronics and Communication Engineering, Sri Sivasubramaniya Nadar College of Engineering, Chennai, 2026 | CGPA 8.5/10

INTERNSHIPS
Firmware Intern, Marina Embedded Systems Pvt Ltd, Chennai | Jan 2026 - Apr 2026 (12 weeks)
- Wrote embedded C drivers for a temperature sensor on an STM32F4 board over I2C.
- Configured timers, GPIO and external interrupts on the STM32 to read a flow meter.
- Debugged I2C timing problems with a logic analyser and the ST-Link SWD debugger.
- Kept firmware in Git and fixed review comments from the senior engineer.

Summer Intern, Ambattur Electronics, Chennai | June 2025 - July 2025 (6 weeks)
- Tested and soldered PCB assemblies for a power meter and logged faults.

PROJECTS
- Smart Irrigation Controller: ESP32 reads soil moisture and switches a pump, sending readings over UART to a GSM module.
- Line Follower Robot: Arduino based robot with IR sensors and PID control, 2nd place at the college robotics event.
- Digital Thermometer: 8051 microcontroller with LCD for the Microprocessors lab.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- Coursework: Microprocessors and Microcontrollers, Embedded Systems, Digital Electronics, Real-Time Operating Systems
- NPTEL: Embedded System Design with ARM (Elite), 2025

SKILLS
Embedded C, STM32, ESP32, Arduino, I2C, SPI, UART, FreeRTOS (basics), Keil, STM32CubeIDE, Git, Python (basic)

ACTIVITIES
- Treasurer, IEEE student branch, 2025-26.
